Do not put both providers into one generic API implementation; use separate adapters behind a shared product layer.

Design rule: reuse the product shell and shared business logic; split provider adapters and only the UI forms whose fields/steps truly differ.
Security rule: OAuth tokens stay server-side and encrypted; never send refresh/access tokens to the browser or log them.
